send: i=0; while [ "$(getprop sys.boot_completed)" != 1 ] && [ $i -lt 900 ]; do sleep 3; i=$((i+3)); done; echo BOOTDONE=$(getprop sys.boot_completed) uptime=$(cut -d' ' -f1 /proc/uptime)

mp() { t0=$(date +'%m-%d %H:%M:%S.000'); echo enforcing=$(getenforce) uptime=$(cut -d' ' -f1 /proc/uptime); cmd battery unplug; cmd battery set present true; cmd battery set status 3; cmd battery set level 50; sleep 3; echo lowbatt_at=$(cut -d' ' -f1 /proc/uptime); cmd battery set level 4; sleep 10; echo notif_at=$(cut -d' ' -f1 /proc/uptime); cmd notification post -t OpenBook mp$1 'MediaPlayer check' >/dev/null; sleep 8; su 0 logcat -d -b main -T "$t0" | grep -E 'RingtonePlayer: (play uri|player.start|error|onCompletion)|MediaPlayer(Native)?: (E|e)rror|AudioTrack: createTrack|AudioSink|openAudioSink|NuPlayer: received error' | tail -n 40; echo plays=$(su 0 logcat -d -b main -T "$t0" | grep -c 'RingtonePlayer: player.start'); echo control_block_failures=$(su 0 logcat -d -b main -T "$t0" | grep -c 'Could not get control block'); echo player_errors=$(su 0 logcat -d -b main -T "$t0" | grep -c 'MediaPlayerNative: error'); echo mediaserver_denials=$(su 0 logcat -d -b all -T "$t0" | grep -cE 'auditd +: type=1400 .*avc:  denied .*scontext=u:r:mediaserver:'); su 0 logcat -d -b all -T "$t0" | grep -E 'auditd +: type=1400 .*avc:  denied' | sed -E 's/.*avc:  denied  (\{[^}]*\}).*scontext=u:r:([^:]*):[^ ]* tcontext=u:(object_)?r:([^:]*):[^ ]* tclass=([^ ]*) permissive=([01]).*/denied \1 \2 \4 \5 permissive=\6/' | sort | uniq -c; su 0 logcat -d -b events -T "$t0" | grep notification_alert; cmd battery reset; }

echo ===MPLAYER-BEGIN===; echo build=$(getprop ro.build.fingerprint); echo power_sounds=$(settings get global power_sounds_enabled) low_battery_sound=$(settings get global low_battery_sound) notification_sound=$(settings get system notification_sound); mp 1; echo ===MPLAYER-END===

echo ===POLICYFIX-BEGIN===; su 0 sh -c 'V=$(cat /vendor/etc/selinux/plat_sepolicy_vers.txt); GV=$(cat /vendor/etc/selinux/genfs_labels_version.txt 2>/dev/null || echo 202404); A="/system/etc/selinux/plat_sepolicy.cil -m -M true -G -N -c 30 /system/etc/selinux/mapping/$V.cil -o /data/local/tmp/sepolicy.fix -f /dev/null"; for f in /system/etc/selinux/mapping/$V.compat.cil /system_ext/etc/selinux/system_ext_sepolicy.cil /system_ext/etc/selinux/mapping/$V.cil /system_ext/etc/selinux/mapping/$V.compat.cil /product/etc/selinux/product_sepolicy.cil /product/etc/selinux/mapping/$V.cil /vendor/etc/selinux/plat_pub_versioned.cil /vendor/etc/selinux/vendor_sepolicy.cil /odm/etc/selinux/odm_sepolicy.cil /system/etc/selinux/plat_sepolicy_genfs_$GV.cil; do [ -f $f ] && A="$A $f"; done; echo "(allow mediaserver audioserver_tmpfs (file (getattr map read write)))" > /data/local/tmp/fix.cil; echo vendor_plat=$V genfs=$GV; cat /data/local/tmp/fix.cil; /system/bin/secilc $A /data/local/tmp/fix.cil; echo secilc_rc=$?; ls -l /data/local/tmp/sepolicy.fix; echo running_policy_bytes=$(wc -c < /sys/fs/selinux/policy); dd if=/data/local/tmp/sepolicy.fix of=/sys/fs/selinux/load bs=16M; echo load_rc=$?; echo enforcing=$(getenforce)'; echo ===POLICYFIX-END===

echo ===AVC-BEGIN===; su 0 dmesg | grep 'avc:  denied' | sed -E 's/^\[[ 0-9.]*\] //; s/.*avc:  denied  (\{[^}]*\}).*scontext=u:r:([^:]*):[^ ]* tcontext=u:object_r:([^:]*):[^ ]* tclass=([^ ]*).*/\1 \2 \3 \4/' | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn; echo ===AVC-END===
echo ===LOGCAT-BEGIN===; su 0 logcat -d -b all | gzip | base64; echo ===LOGCAT-END===
echo ===DMESG-BEGIN===; su 0 dmesg | gzip | base64; echo ===DMESG-END===
